{"code":"import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
# Clear scene
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
# blue material
mat = bpy.data.materials.get('ToyBlue') or bpy.data.materials.new('ToyBlue')
mat.diffuse_color = (0.035, 0.22, 0.8, 1.0)
mat.metallic = 0.0
mat.roughness = 0.38

def box(name, loc, dims, bevel=0.018):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc)
    ob=bpy.context.object
    ob.name=name
    ob.dimensions=dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    ob.data.materials.append(mat)
    bev=ob.modifiers.new('Soft toy edges','BEVEL')
    bev.width=bevel; bev.segments=3
    return ob
# Posts and top beam exactly positioned/sized in meters
left=box('LeftPost',(-1,0,1),(0.2,0.2,2.0))
right=box('RightPost',(1,0,1),(0.2,0.2,2.0))
beam=box('Beam',(0,0,2.1),(2.2,0.2,0.2))
# slender XZ-plane diagonal at rear (+Y) from lower-left toward upper-right
p1=Vector((-0.88,0.20,0.22)); p2=Vector((0.88,0.20,1.90))
mid=(p1+p2)/2; length=(p2-p1).length
brace=box('RearBrace',mid,(0.09,0.10,length),0.012)
# cube long axis starts Z; rotate about Y to align its Z axis to diagonal XZ direction
brace.rotation_euler[1]=math.atan2((p2-p1).x,(p2-p1).z)
# world unit meters
bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system='METRIC'
bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.length_unit='METERS'
# Groundless simple display; select components
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in (left,right,beam,brace): o.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=beam
